name: arabiccheck
description: Arabic-first, offline spelling and grammar checker for the browser (Arabic + English).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p eval
scripts.build: npm run build -w @arabiccheck/core && npm run build -w @arabiccheck/checker-en -w @arabiccheck/checker-ar && npm run build -w @arabiccheck/worker && npm run build -w @arabiccheck/playground
